text:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock down the regional routing + tenant isolation scope for the long-term infra roadmap. Goal: what goes into Q4 cookdown vs. longer-term research.

maria: +1. Customers asking for deterministic failover and per-tenant cost allocations. Need to be clear on launch gates.

sam: can we list the minimal acceptance criteria? i.e. latency SLA per-region, tenant blast radius, rollout API.

jules: For ML/ops: also need rollover behavior for model variants (quantized fallbacks). If routing drops to a cheaper variant, we need quality guardrails.

alex: Proposal (short):
- Phase 1 (Q4): regional affinity + soft-failover to nearest region, tenant tagging, basic isolation lanes (compute pools)
- Phase 2 (H1 next year): strict tenant slices + reserved pools + cross-region evacuation plan
- Phase 3: per-tenant routing policies + automated cost-aware routing (batching/quantization profiles)

ben-sre: ops note: Phase 1 must include an evacuation playbook and a chaos test run. We can't ship affinity without SLOs for cross-region failovers.

maria: Acceptance criteria for Phase 1 (draft):
- 99th pct tail latency increase <= 20% for affinity on average workloads
- Failover < 30s for region-to-region fallback (measured in canary)
- Tenant isolation: noisy-tenant throttles that prevent >10% perf impact on co-tenants
- Visibility: Console exposes per-route latency + per-tenant cost breakdown

sam: +1 to those metrics. Also add a contract: "routing policy is declarative and versioned via API" — product wants rollout and rollbacks.

jules: On model variants: add a quality regression check. If fallback model yields perplexity delta > X on customer prompt set, block automatic fallback. We can start with a conservative threshold.

alex: Risk/Scope negotiation: customers want full per-tenant isolations now, but that bumps cost and infra complexity. We should surface tradeoffs in a short doc for sales/pm.

maria: I'll draft an "affinity vs isolation" decision memo with cost delta estimates and options: (a) soft affinity (Phase1), (b) hard slices (Phase2), (c) dedicated hardware (enterprise).

ben-sre: ops asks for runbook templates and an SRE sign-off checklist before Phase1 can be scheduled.

infra-bot: Reminder: sandbox cluster for routing tests created at sandbox-rtg-02. Use that for chaos and failover rehearsals.

alex: Next steps: Maria + Ben prepare memo + runbook this week. Jules and Sam to define model-fallback QA thresholds. I'll sync with sales on customer asks and prioritize in the roadmap PR. 

maria: pinging @sam @jules — can you share thresholds by Thu EOD?

sam: yes, will post a short doc and a test script snippet.

jules: will supply eval set and gating numbers.

alex: Great. We'll reconvene next Wed to lock Phase1 launch criteria and put into the roadmap board. :calendar:
